topLine: Reinforcement-learning controller predicts and avoids tearing instabilities in the DIII-D tokamak.

items.headline: Reinforcement-learning controller predicts and avoids tearing instabilities in the DIII-D tokamak
items.summary: A Princeton and PPPL team (Jaemin Seo, Egemen Kolemen) trained a controller on past DIII-D data that forecast tearing-mode instabilities up to 300 milliseconds ahead and adjusted plasma shape and beam power to avoid them during a live experiment, rather than suppressing them after onset. Published in Nature; demonstrated on one tokamak and proposed as a step toward stable high-performance ITER scenarios.
